courses.overview: 從「伊泰普水電站」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 長江三峽大壩工程
related.why: 把「伊泰普水電站」與「長江三峽大壩工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant with Three Gorges Dam Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 水電樞紐都需要統整水庫、進水、壓力水路、機組和輸電，並評估環境與河流調度。
related.transferEn: Hydropower complexes integrate reservoir, intake, pressure-water routes, machines and transmission with river and environmental management.
related.difference: 伊泰普跨巴西與巴拉圭；三峽兼有大型航運配置，水文、治理和營運目標不同。
related.differenceEn: Itaipu spans Brazil and Paraguay; Three Gorges includes major navigation facilities, with different hydrology, governance and operating objectives.
practice: 標出水路和電路的交接
比較水庫調度的多重目標
用假想水頭與流量作量綱檢查
practiceEn: Check dimensions using illustrative head and flow values

related.title: 道格灘離岸風電場
related.why: 把「伊泰普水電站」與「道格灘離岸風電場」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant with Dogger Bank offshore wind farm: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: Dogger Bank 泰恩港陸上運維基地（郵遞區號代表點）
place.nameEn: Dogger Bank onshore Port of Tyne O&M base (postcode reference point)
place.address: Dogger Bank O&M Base, Enterprise Way, East Side, Tyne Dock, South Shields, NE33 5SW, UK
place.addressEn: Dogger Bank O&M Base, Enterprise Way, East Side, Tyne Dock, South Shields, NE33 5SW, UK
place.coordinateScope: ONS 官方郵遞區號目錄（2026 年 5 月）所列 NE33 5SW 代表座標；不是建築入口、離岸風場中心或風機位置。地圖固定於此座標，基地街址另外列出。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Representative NE33 5SW coordinate in the official ONS Postcode Directory (May 2026); not a building entrance, offshore-farm center or turbine location. The map pins this coordinate; the base address is listed separately.

related.transfer: 大型再生能源都把自然能量轉成機械和電力，再透過電網介面交付。
related.transferEn: Large renewable-energy projects convert natural energy into mechanical and electrical energy before grid delivery.
related.difference: 伊泰普以可調度水流驅動水輪機；離岸風電受風況影響，儲能條件、機組配置和維護環境不同。
related.differenceEn: Itaipu uses controlled water flow through turbines; offshore wind varies with wind conditions, with different storage context, machine layouts and maintenance environments.
practice: 畫出水輪與風輪的能量鏈
比較可控輸入與天候輸入
列出容量之外應記錄的運行資料
practiceEn: Draw hydro and wind energy chains
List operating data needed beyond nameplate capacity

courses.summary: 伊泰普位於巴拉那河的巴西與巴拉圭交界。1973 年的條約與 1984 年開始發電，顯示大型機電工程同時需要長期制度安排與分期整合。地圖為大壩的概略代表點，不是施工入口或機組座標。
courses.summaryEn: Itaipu sits on the Paraná River between Brazil and Paraguay. The 1973 treaty and start of generation in 1984 show how a major electromechanical project combines institutional arrangements with staged integration. The map is an approximate dam reference point, not a construction entrance or unit coordinate.

history.title: 簽署伊泰普條約
history.text: 巴西與巴拉圭以條約建立共同開發水力資源的框架。
history.textEn: Brazil and Paraguay established a treaty framework for joint hydropower development.

history.title: 開始發電
history.text: 伊泰普於五月開始發電，電站由建設轉入分期機組運轉。
history.textEn: Itaipu began generating in May as construction transitioned into staged unit operation.

courses.connection: 在地圖辨識跨境水體，再以課程圖分清水量、軸功率與兩國電氣介面。
courses.connectionEn: Locate the cross-border water resource, then separate water balance, shaft power and national-grid interfaces.

courses.connection: 從「伊泰普水電站」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
